dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Strongly concave trailing edge spline with a deep inward curvature initiating immediately below the apex, forming a falcate profile.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Linear anterior margin at an approximate 45-degree angle relative to the horizontal longitudinal axis of the visible body segment.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximate 3.8:1 ratio of total visible longitudinal base length to maximum vertical fin height.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced elongated posterior ridge tapering gradually from the base of the dorsal fin toward the caudal region.
